related_resources.reason: The complete all-dimension proof via Legendre, an auxiliary prime from Dirichlet, and induction; section 14.3 was inspected in its open-access HTML text. Our presentation separates the local-value and prime-support steps.
Proof that 3x^3+4y^3+5z^3=0 is locally solvable at every completion but has no nonzero rational solution. Used only as a cited contrasting counterexample, not presented as proved.
Includes Witt cancellation; manuscript gives an explicit reflection proof for one-dimensional cancellation.
Integral local equivalence versus global Z-equivalence and form genera.
Statement of the local-global principle for quadratic forms.
